mechanisms.name: particle_impact
mechanisms.description: Particles entrained in flow impact surfaces at velocity, transferring kinetic energy sufficient for ignition.

rating_criteria.0: No particles possible AND velocity < 30 m/s
rating_criteria.1: Particles unlikely OR velocity well below threshold
rating_criteria.2: Particles possible, velocity moderate, unfavorable impact angle
rating_criteria.3: Particles likely, velocity near threshold, favorable geometry
rating_criteria.4: Particles confirmed, velocity > 30 m/s (100 ft/s), perpendicular impact on flammable target

typical_mitigations: Use nonflammable target material at impact site

mechanisms.name: rapid_pressurization
mechanisms.description: Rapid compression of oxygen gas heats trapped gas pockets above autoignition temperature of exposed nonmetals.

rating_criteria.0: No rapid pressurization possible AND no nonmetals exposed
rating_criteria.1: Slow pressurization (>1s) with minimal nonmetal exposure
rating_criteria.2: Moderate pressurization rate, some nonmetal exposure
rating_criteria.3: Fast pressurization, nonmetal near dead-end, pressure ratio approaching AIT
rating_criteria.4: Pressurization <1s, exposed nonmetal at dead-end, Tf > AIT (computed via adiabatic formula)

typical_mitigations: Install flow restrictor to slow pressurization rate
Replace nonmetal seals with metal seals at dead-ends

mechanisms.name: flow_friction
mechanisms.description: Nonmetal material exposed to high-velocity flow with vibration or erosion generates frictional heating.

rating_criteria.1: Nonmetal present but low velocity and no vibration
rating_criteria.2: Moderate flow with some vibration potential
rating_criteria.3: High-velocity flow over nonmetal with vibration
rating_criteria.4: Documented conditions matching real-world fire scenarios

typical_mitigations: Eliminate nonmetals from high-velocity flow paths

mechanisms.name: resonance
mechanisms.description: Sonic jet into a cavity creates acoustic resonance heating flammable material at closed end.

rating_criteria.0: No sonic flow possible AND no cavities
rating_criteria.1: Subsonic flow or no enclosed cavities
rating_criteria.2: Sonic flow possible but no flammable material at resonant point
rating_criteria.3: Sonic flow into cavity with nonmetal present
rating_criteria.4: Confirmed resonance conditions with flammable material at closed end

typical_mitigations: Use nonflammable materials at cavity ends
Design to avoid sonic flow conditions

mechanisms.name: mechanical_impact
mechanisms.description: Single or repeated impact on nonmetal or reactive metal in oxygen. LOX increases sensitivity.

rating_criteria.2: Moderate impact, material has some sensitivity
rating_criteria.3: Repeated impact on sensitive material in GOX

typical_mitigations: Eliminate impact sources (valve slam, water hammer)
Use impact-resistant materials per NASA-STD-6001B Test 13
Add damping to reduce impact energy

mechanisms.name: galling_friction
mechanisms.description: Metal-to-metal rubbing with rapid motion and high loads generates heat sufficient for ignition.

rating_criteria.2: Some relative motion under moderate loads
rating_criteria.3: Rapid motion, high loads, chatter possible
rating_criteria.4: Confirmed galling conditions (valve chatter, high-speed rubbing)

typical_mitigations: Use dissimilar metals to resist galling

mechanisms.name: fresh_metal_exposure
mechanisms.description: Quick-oxidizing metal (Al, Ti) has protective oxide removed, exposing fresh surface that reacts exothermically.

rating_criteria.1: Reactive metal in bulk form with no oxide removal mechanism
rating_criteria.2: Reactive metal with possible oxide damage
rating_criteria.3: Thin-section reactive metal with oxide removal mechanism
rating_criteria.4: Fresh Al/Ti surface exposed in favorable ignition configuration

typical_mitigations: Avoid aluminum and titanium in oxygen-wetted paths
Use bulk configurations to maximize heat dissipation
Protect oxide layer from mechanical damage

mechanisms.name: static_discharge
mechanisms.description: Electrostatic charge buildup on isolated surface discharges through flammable material.

rating_criteria.0: All surfaces grounded, no charge buildup possible
rating_criteria.2: Some isolation possible but discharge energy low
rating_criteria.3: Isolated surface with discharge potential near nonmetal
rating_criteria.4: Confirmed charge accumulation with discharge into flammable material

mechanisms.name: electrical_arc
mechanisms.description: Electrical power source creates arc with sufficient energy to ignite nearby flammable material.

rating_criteria.0: No electrical power in oxygen-wetted zone
rating_criteria.1: Power present but well-isolated from oxygen
rating_criteria.2: Power near oxygen path with moderate isolation
rating_criteria.3: Arc possible near flammable material in oxygen
rating_criteria.4: Confirmed electrical source with arc potential contacting flammable material

typical_mitigations: Isolate electrical circuits from oxygen-wetted surfaces

mechanisms.name: chemical_reaction
mechanisms.description: Reactant-specific chemical reactions (e.g., H2 leak near O2, Al + PCTFE) produce ignition energy.

rating_criteria.3: Reactive pair in proximity with credible mixing path
rating_criteria.4: Known reactive pair with confirmed contact potential

typical_mitigations: Eliminate reactive chemical pairs from system

mechanisms.name: thermal_runaway
mechanisms.description: High SA/V ratio material (fines, porous) with poor heat dissipation slowly oxidizes to ignition (hours to months).

rating_criteria.0: No high SA/V materials, good heat dissipation
rating_criteria.1: Low SA/V materials with adequate cooling
rating_criteria.2: Moderate SA/V with some heat dissipation concerns
rating_criteria.3: High SA/V porous material with limited cooling
rating_criteria.4: Fines/porous material with poor heat dissipation in prolonged O2 exposure

typical_mitigations: Avoid porous and high SA/V materials in oxygen service
Limit exposure time for susceptible materials

mechanisms.name: other
mechanisms.description: Lightning, explosive charges, personnel smoking, open flames, fragments from bursting vessels, welding, engine exhaust.

rating_criteria.3: External source credible during some operations

typical_mitigations: Enforce hot work permits near oxygen systems
